prosody.lang: The best time is the morning; as the mist lifts, the monastery looks stunning from the valley. You walk up through the forest on a steep path, so wear comfortable shoes. In winter the road and the path can be snowy and icy. Entry is paid, and the

museum pass is valid. Current status: since 2010 a permitted service has been held in mid-August in some years. It does not happen every year, and the date can change. Local tip: on the way back, stop by the stream in the valley for trout or
. Did you know? The name Sumela is thought to come from a Greek word for black, after
, the Black Mountain. Your next stop is the
Mansion, about forty-four kilometres by car, around fifty minutes.
